newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Electronics shrs end limit down.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Electronics shrs end limit down.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Electronics Industrial Co Ltd's new shares ended their first day of trading at their lower limit of 21,200 won per share, down 1,800 on the day, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
Hyundai is the semiconductor and consumer electronics goods manufacturing arm of the Hyundai Group.
Volume was thin, with only 1,050 shares changing hands.
Hyundai held its initial public offering on November 19-20, and the 10 million new shares were subscribed at a price of 20,000 won per share.
